Open Start and type your company name and your own numbers in the yellow cells: the hourly pay of a helper, the margin you want on a custom order, the deposit share, the days a proof may wait and the profit per helper hour you need.

Events lists every fair and market with the stall fee, helper hours, travel and sales. The cost of goods, the profit, the profit per helper hour and the packing check fill in. Event lines holds the products you took and sold at each fair.
Event costs, Event stock lists and Event staff shifts hold the detail of each fair: every cost with its day, every product to bring with the units packed, and every shift with its hours and pay.

Event applications is your calendar of fairs to apply to, with the deadline, the fee and the answer. Event notes and Event leads record the footfall, the weather, the best seller and the people to follow up.

Custom orders keeps every custom and corporate gift order with the quote, the deposit, the due date and the maker; the balance, margin and due check fill in. Quotes, proofs, deliveries and invoices follow each order.

Corporate clients shows the orders and spend of each business and who ordered again. Gift box options and Price tiers hold your sets, your volume steps and your setup fee. Display equipment lists what you take to a stall.
Products shows the units taken and sold at fairs with the advice for the next one. Seasons holds the demand factor of each month.

Use the 14 calculators before you decide: event profit, stock plan, break-even, sell-through, stall fee, helper cost, travel, quote, volume discount, deposit, gift set, production time and a what-if grid.
Read the Fairs and Custom Orders sheet and the Charts every week: profit at fairs, applications waiting, open custom orders, proofs waiting, deposits and late invoices.

One row for each gift shop or boutique (active, on hold or prospect) with terms, tier and minimum order; the orders, sales, last order, usual gap, open balance and reorder check fill in.
Wholesale orders with total, margin and due ship date
One row for each shop order with the subtotal, discount and the date it must ship; the lines, total, cost of goods, margin and the minimum order check fill in from the order lines.
Products on each wholesale order with price and cost
One row for each product on an order with the units and the wholesale price; the line total, unit cost, line cost and margin fill in.
Wholesale invoices with due date, payment and days late
One row for each invoice with the due date and what was paid; the open amount, the days late of open invoices, the payment check and the days to pay fill in.
Payments received from shops with days to pay
One row for each payment with the invoice, the amount and the method; the shop, the days from the invoice to the payment and the days against the due date fill in.
The price and product list you give a shop
One row for each product you offer a shop with the wholesale and retail price, the minimum pack and the lead days; the shop margin, your margin and the units sold in 12 months fill in.
Tiers with discount and minimum order
The price tiers you give a shop with the discount and the minimum order; the account list reads the tier and the tier calculator reads the discount.
Samples sent to shops with cost and orders after
One row for each sample pack with the product, the units and the day it was sent; the cost, the days to send, the orders of the shop in the 90 days after and the payback fill in.
Calls, visits and messages with each shop and the next step
One row for each call, visit or message with a shop with the hours spent and the next step; the cost of your time and the follow-up check fill in.
Reorder dates from the usual gap between a shop orders
One row for each shop and product it orders again and again with the last order and the usual gap in days; the next expected order, the days overdue and the reminder check fill in.
Notes about each shop: pricing, delivery, payment and range
One row for each note about a shop with the topic and who wrote it; the days since the note fill in.
Shipments with freight cost and transit days
One row for each shipped order with the method, the weight, the boxes and what the courier charged; the shop, the freight as a share of the order, the transit days and the shipping check fill in.
Items a shop sent back or claimed, with the credit
One row for each return or claim from a shop with the product, the reason and the credit; the shop, the credit note number and the days since fill in.
Credit notes issued to shops and when they were used
One row for each credit note with the amount and the day it was taken off an invoice; the reason, the open credit, the days open and the credit check fill in.
Sales and margin of each shop by month
One row for each shop and month with the orders, the sales and the margin in money; the margin as a share of the sales and the average order fill in.
Payment terms with the early payment discount
The payment terms you offer with the days and the discount for paying early; the early payment calculator reads these.
Shops you want to win, with source, status and next step
One row for each shop that asked about your range or that you want to approach with the source, the status and the next step; the days since first contact and the follow-up check fill in.
Requests for your catalogue and line sheet
One row for each shop that asked for your catalogue with the day you sent it and whether it led to an order; the days to send and the send check fill in.
The 24 products with wholesale price and cost
The 24 products with prices, unit cost and cure days (the days a candle or soap rests before it is ready); the wholesale margin and the sales to shops fill in.
